tools.Name: CLI-Anything
tools.Description: An automated pipeline that transforms any software with a codebase into an agent-native CLI tool.
tools.Use_Case: Making professional desktop software (Blender, LibreOffice, GIMP, etc.) controllable by AI agents.

tools.Name: Scientific Agent Skills
tools.Description: A collection of 138 ready-to-use research skills covering genomics, drug discovery, and scientific data processing.
tools.Use_Case: Transforming coding agents into specialized research assistants for scientific multi-step workflows.

tools.Name: CloakBrowser
tools.Description: Stealth Chromium binary with source-level fingerprint patches that passes advanced bot detection.
tools.Use_Case: Automated web data collection and agent browsing without being blocked by services like Cloudflare Turnstile.
